# CheckCheck

> > Fast, dual-expert authentication service for luxury goods and sneakers using AI-powered verification

CheckCheck provides professional authentication services for luxury handbags (Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Hermès, Gucci, Prada, Dior, Burberry) and sneakers (Air Jordans) through a dual-expert review process. The platform serves resellers, TikTok Shop sellers, and individual buyers with real-time verification, certificates of authenticity, and API integration for marketplaces.

## Key Topics

- Dual-expert authentication
- Luxury handbag verification
- Sneaker authentication
- Counterfeit detection
- Louis Vuitton authentication
- Air Jordan verification
- TikTok Shop selling
- Resale market protection
- Certificate of authenticity
- Real-time verification
- AI-powered authentication
- Secondary market authentication
- Reseller reputation protection
- Fake luxury detection
- Authentication API
